# pack git flow to the Taskfile

Move the per-repository git flow — the `start`, `stop`, `progress`, `issue`, `done` aliases that [git_flow](../../bin/git_flow) writes into a repository's `.git/config` — into a Taskfile ([[DOT-141]]) that lives with the project, so that the flow is versioned and shared with the repository instead of being installed into each clone's local config.
